title: Fix all seven recorded manual web-test regressions without weakening ERP controls
description: Resolve every discrete finding in NEWERP网页测试错误.xlsx: new inquiry must obtain the existing authorized system default currency/exchange-rate rather than require manual rate entry; validity days must use integral day increments; tabs must retain more than three pages and preserve a user's unsaved page state when switching; inquiry creation must work and inquiry/sales-order export views must offer an explicit search/preview action before download; opening a genuinely new document must not silently reuse earlier form values and must provide a clear-all action. Reuse the existing parameter-authorized default endpoint and existing document authorization, validation, transaction and audit paths. Do not add external FX lookup, SQL, schema, permissions, production data access, or privileged fallback. User-entered values remain editable and server-side authority remains decisive.
acceptance_criteria: A menu-authorized user can open a new inquiry and receive only the existing authorized system defaults for currency and positive exchange rate; unavailable or unauthorized defaults fail closed without manufacturing a rate, while save still uses the existing server-side validation, authorization, transaction and audit paths.

Inquiry validity days is an integer-day input with an integral browser step and client validation; a fractional wheel increment cannot be submitted as a valid day count, while existing server validation remains authoritative.

The tab bar no longer evicts the fourth and later pages. Switching tabs preserves each page's unsaved, non-sensitive UI state for the browser session without serializing tokens, passwords, authorization decisions, or persisted record mutations; closing a tab discards its saved state.

Inquiry creation is reachable and succeeds through the existing authorized flow. Both inquiry export and sales-order export expose a visible search/preview action that applies date, status and keyword filters before download, and the downloaded file uses the same authorized filter parameters. No export may bypass its existing permission or data-scope checks.

A genuinely new document starts from documented defaults only and never carries prior form values. The form exposes a clear-all action that restores defaults in one operation, while edit/copy/source-prefill flows retain only their explicit, labelled behavior.

Focused browserless JavaScript regression tests cover default loading/failure, integral valid-days control, tab retention/state lifecycle, export search parameters, new-form isolation and clear-all behavior. Relevant API/unit tests cover default authorization and fail-closed behavior. Safe Release build with analyzers/warnings-as-errors and the full unit suite pass; retain any real environment-blocker evidence instead of claiming browser acceptance.

human_gate.reason: Repository-only UI and existing authorized-default behavior; no schema, production, deployment, or irreversible action.
